## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 1:00 PM Eastern on Aug. 6, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot grew this week, rounding to 7 points. The average number of likely voters saying they plan to vote for a Republican fell from 43.5 percent on July 31 to 42.5 percent today, a full point, while the number who say they plan to vote for a Democrat fell less than half a percent, from 49.4 to 49.0.
